fichas.title: Soil: formation, loosening and improvement
fichas.summary: Guidance for forming, loosening, improving and consolidating soils in earthworks and landscape construction. Soil formation should provide a correct profile, water run-off, compaction, and load-bearing capacity appropriate to its use. The page includes guideline tolerances, minimum deformation-modulus requirements, and a matrix of soil-improvement processes and their applications.
uses: Prepare soil formations for earthworks and roads
